landing.heroDescription: A hand-curated channel for urban culture, food, design and travel. No ads, no algorithm — just the shows editors love, from creators you've never heard of.
landing.portfolioHeading: Click the Moment, Live the Story
landing.why01Body: Every show on Clickit is picked by a human. You won't find a recommendation engine pushing you toward six more things about the same thing.
landing.why02Body: We partner with filmmakers directly and pay them per stream, not per view-time. That means 35-minute episodes that take 35 minutes to watch.
landing.why03Body: Travel, health, music, comedy, cooking, kids, poetry, cinema, tech — 15 original programs produced from the UAE by Spacelight Studios.
landing.faq1A: Clickit is a curated streaming service for original shows produced in Abu Dhabi. Every show is hand-picked by our editors.
landing.faq2A: Clickit is free during open beta. No subscription required — just sign up and start watching.
landing.faq3A: Any modern browser on desktop, tablet, or mobile. Our shows stream via YouTube for maximum compatibility.
landing.faq4Q: Where does the content come from?
landing.faq4A: All content is original, produced by Spacelight Studios FZ LLC from Yas Creative Hub, Abu Dhabi.
landing.faq5A: We currently have 15 original programs spanning travel, health, music, comedy, cooking, kids, poetry, cinema, tech, and more.

about.metaDescription: About Clickit Story and the editorial point of view behind the platform.
about.title: A viewing platform built by editorial taste, not an algorithm.
about.intro: Clickit Story brings original programming from Abu Dhabi into a calmer, more intentional viewing environment. The thesis is simple: less noise, clearer selection, and a tone that respects the viewer's time.
about.section1Body: The platform is programmed like a magazine or a channel, with attention to pacing, mood, and discovery order instead of overwhelming the viewer with an overcrowded interface.
about.section2Body: The programming starts from the city but does not stay narrow. Travel, food, health, music, and design appear here as adjacent lenses on the region.
about.section3Body: The product is designed to encourage complete viewing of an episode or season, with clear navigation, saved progress, and room to discover what comes next without noise.

faq.q1Answer: Clickit Story (CIT) is a UAE-based digital media company producing original programs across travel, health, music, comedy, cooking, tech, poetry, and more. This platform is our cinematic streaming home — every Clickit original, in one place.
faq.q2Question: Is Clickit Story free to watch?
faq.q2Answer: Yes — every show is free. No subscription, no paywall.
faq.q3Answer: You can browse and watch without an account. Signing in lets you save shows to your list, track progress, and pick up where you left off.
faq.q4Question: Is the content available in Arabic and English?
faq.q4Answer: Yes. Every show has titles and descriptions in both languages, and the entire interface switches between English and Arabic.
faq.q5Answer: From Yas Creative Hub in Abu Dhabi, UAE. We're operated by Spacelight Studios FZ LLC.
faq.q6Question: Can I download episodes for offline viewing?
faq.q6Answer: Not yet — Clickit Story uses YouTube's streaming infrastructure for video delivery. Offline download is on our roadmap.
faq.q7Question: How do I report a problem with a video?
faq.q7Answer: Use the Support page to send us a message. Include the show title, episode number, and a short description of what you saw.
faq.q8Answer: Yes — our catalog grows as new seasons wrap production. Follow our social channels or visit the Coming Soon page for the latest.
